verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cloudflare publishes source for parts of the Workers stack on GitHub: the workers-sdk repo containing the Wrangler CLI and a local simulator, and a link to the workerd runtime repo. However, no evidence states the license terms or shows that the hosted Workers platform itself is open source, so only part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: explicit open-license (e.g. OSI license) documentation for these repos, evidence that the core runtime/platform source is open, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
